Status: Inactivated May 1996. Sold to the Chilean Navy May 2009. Towed to Atlantic Marine Alabama shipyard, Mobile, Alabama, September 2009 for three-month refit. Commissioned in Chilean Navy on 10 February 2010 and renamed Almirante Montt.[1]

Cancelled when 95.3% complete,
transferred to the Maritime Administration,
laid up in the James River Reserve Fleet,
scrapped in 2011
